description.value: The Bunker is a cafe located in Whistler, BC, operating under a name that suggests a distinctive, perhaps underground-themed atmosphere suited to a mountain resort town. As a cafe in one of Canada's premier cycling and outdoor destinations, it is potentially a useful stop for touring cyclists passing through the Whistler corridor.
